interfaces.export_saved(plan_path=PLAN,export=False: Immediate source_only with reads/writes/scientific_array/GPU calls0; no plan or marker read. export=True does terminal/release gate then saved-scalar CPU export.
interfaces.CLI: python -m tools.export_fno_local_pair [--plan PLAN] --export; default is zero IO/exit0; required plot missing/unavailable/failed persists completed_incomplete and returns exit1
interfaces.terminal_inputs(plan_path=PLAN): CPU project saved JSON/scalars only, plus actual WSL /proc identities; never call FNO request_contract/model/prepare/inference APIs
interfaces.full120_metrics: Recompute only complete fixed120 signed U/S/hot mean+worst from saved per-case scalars and verify saved aggregate; missing/partial4800/nonfinite/zero-reference yields null, never subset means

actual_gate: authentic frozen FNO science/source binding to true FNO rootreview
saved summary completed or failed; status.phase terminal
actual external_launch.status terminal; genuine saved guard_process and child_process pid/start_ticks/argv
both exact processes exited in common WSL /proc; direct parent and actual child argv match
current FNO driver/guard source SHA equals genuine execution source pins
negative_policy: A genuine closed/exited negative may be reported after CPU release; protocol/scientific qualification remains false, fixed120 partial endpoints stay null. Manifest status represents export artifacts only: both plot groups saved gives completed, otherwise completed_incomplete/CLI exit1. Existing incomplete artifacts are preserved for root review, never automatically overwritten. Missing closed clock or exact process identity/exit blocks export.

reference.future_read: Root-approved export gate only; verify saved index SHA; read JSON parameter/config/cost metadata, never PT/stat array bodies; unavailable parameter count remains null

outputs.plot_sources: two saved scalar loss.jsonl logs and saved genuine fixed0/fixed4800 full120 readout aggregates plus old4800 reference
outputs.plot_missing_status: missing/unavailable/failed explicit in metrics+manifest+BRIEF; completed_incomplete and CLI exit1; no nonexistent plot links
outputs.ownership_cache: Identity-bound completed cache reused only with unchanged source/input/artifact hashes; incomplete/interrupted/changed output preserved for root review; no automatic overwrite

report_policy: native25 versus grid25 is the single local25 origin factor inside the matched new decoder
old FNO absolute U/signedS/hot mean+worst, real saved train/attempt wall and parameter differences are explicit
actual closed inner clock and observed external launch-to-child-exit wall reported separately
unknown cost intervals and timeout are nonexact; CPU export approval does not imply experimental PASS
actual first complete TRAIN gradient metadata and exact named initial tensor pairing reported
relative pair gate does not automatically choose a new decoder with larger old-reference errors
TRAIN120 is not held20/generalization/final solver qualification
